A [[Gran]] '''senator''' was active during the [[New Republic Era]] and [[Ahsoka Tano]]'s [[quest to find Ezra Bridger]].<ref name="Part Three" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The character first appeared via a hologram in "[[Part Three: Time to Fly]],"<ref name="Part Three" /> the third episode of the live-action [[Star Wars: Ahsoka|''Ahsoka'' television series]] which premiered on [[Disney+]] on [[August 29]], [[2023]].<ref name="Release">{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-premiere-date|text=''Ahsoka'' Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> They were portrayed by [[Erica Duke]].<ref name="GettySenators">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess#!asset/4qxr46mwj6qgc7cpkj3fv9pg|text=The Walt Disney Studios All Access - Ahsoka online trailer uhd r709f stills 230329.087658|date=2023-04-07}}</ref>
